limitations: SemanticRequest.interpretation is a proved mathematical input; tactics do not construct topology, true Adams pages or external naturality assumptions from strings.
This is a caller-bound finite semantic result under the inherited interpretations, not an unconditional original-topology theorem.
reviewed_claims: ResultMatches fixes caller object/page/degree and entire input/output lists; the checker also validates BoundWire, so extra or missing list entries cannot hide behind default-false coordinate indexing.

RequestedHolds includes exact request matching, the same interpretation full-page Holds, caller-key DifferentialAt, and coordinates of the identical endpoint points in the semantic differential statement.
request_sound uses both halves of checkResult and does not infer semantic data from the certificate.
The batch uses the specific wire and interpretation paired with each SemanticRequest.
Five executable counterexamples reject wrong object, page, degree, source and target; the real6651 single and batch examples use caller-fixed values.
